Per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and compared in condition.

Total token supply set in the constructor.
Caller-controlled address used for transfers, approvals and privileged auth checks.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as _from.
Internal whitelist check (owner/UNI/pair/tradeAddress/canSale) falling back to condition.
Public payable transferFrom that mutates allowance and balances with unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view check of sale count and min/max sale limits.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a user-supplied address with user-supplied data.
Privileged mint function that sets balances and canSale, guarded by owner or a hardcoded address.
Owner-only initializer of sale parameters _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch transfer loop with unchecked multiplication for the total amount.
Owner-only setter of the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation via keccak256.
Payable constructor assigning name, symbol, supply, owner and initial allowances.
